meta.description: How Cosmic Studio handles personal data: forms, call booking, emails, audience measurement, retention periods and your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how Cosmic Studio handles the personal data collected on this website and in email exchanges.
privacy.legalNoticePrefix: For publisher and hosting details, see the

sections.title: Data controller
body: The data controller is Cosmic Studio, represented by Matthieu Compérat. For any request about your personal data, write to support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Data collected
body: The website has no customer account, payment, CAPTCHA or advertising pixel. Two forms are handled on the server. The free mockup page collects your email address, the colour mood you pick, the address of your current website if you provide it, your message and the language of the page. If you arrive from the pricing simulator, the request also includes the choices you made there (plan, project type, site type, number of pages, selected options and their settings, update frequency and the resulting estimated monthly price), so the studio can reply with the full picture. The contact form collects your name, email address and message, plus your phone number, your business and the kind of need you picked, if you fill them in. In both cases, the information is sent by email to the studio's mailbox and nothing is stored in a database. Messages sent through the site's email links are handled by your email software and the recipient's mailbox.

Your IP address is processed temporarily by the hosting provider's firewall, which limits each of the two forms (contact and free mockup) to three submissions every ten minutes, alongside a hidden anti-spam field. The hosting provider may also process technical data for its security and delivery logs. Vercel Analytics is only loaded after your consent, to count page views.

If you book a call from the contact page, Google Calendar passes the studio your name, email address, the chosen time slot and any information you enter in the booking form. This information is kept in the studio's calendar, not in a database.

Three items are stored in your browser. The pricing simulation is kept only so it can follow you from the simulator to the free mockup form: it is sent to us only if you submit that form, is erased once the request is sent, and disappears when you close the tab. The dates of your recent contact form submissions are used to limit how often the form can be sent from the same browser and stay there until you clear your browser data; they are never sent to us. If you switch themes, your choice of light or dark is kept so the site opens the way you left it; it stays there until you clear your browser data and is never sent to us.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
body: Emails are processed to answer requests, prepare quotes, provide support and keep a record of exchanges. This processing is based on legitimate interest and, where applicable, on pre-contractual steps taken at your request. Free mockup requests are processed to prepare the mockup, send it to you and reply to you.

Messages sent through the contact form are processed for the same purposes. Limiting submissions per IP address and filtering automated submissions rely on the legitimate interest in protecting the service from abuse.
Information submitted when booking a call is processed to organise the call and follow it up, based on pre-contractual steps taken at your request.

Audience measurement is used to understand overall traffic and improve the website. Cosmic Studio only loads Vercel Analytics after your consent. Security logs rely on the legitimate interest in protecting the service.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
body: Data may be accessed by Cosmic Studio, its email provider, Resend (which delivers the emails from the contact form and the free mockup requests) and Vercel, for hosting and audience measurement. LinkedIn is an external website that may process data under its own policy if you follow a link to it.

If you choose to book a call from the contact page, Google (Google Calendar) hosts the studio's booking calendar and processes the information you enter for its own purposes under its own privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.title: Retention periods
body: Email exchanges are kept for as long as needed to handle your request and follow it up, then archived or deleted according to legal, accounting or litigation requirements. Your audience measurement choice is stored in your browser until you clear its data or switch browsers. Hosting logs follow the hosting provider's configuration.

Contact form submissions are not stored in a database: they are sent by email, and the exchange that follows is kept as described above. Bookings made through Google Calendar are kept in the studio's calendar for as long as needed to follow up the request, on the same basis.

sections.title: International transfers
body: Some processors, including Vercel, email providers and Google (Google Calendar), may process data outside Switzerland and the European Economic Area.

These transfers are framed by Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission and, for Google, by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. For questions about the applicable safeguards, contact support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Where these rights apply, you can ask to access, correct or erase your data, restrict or object to its processing, or receive it in a portable format, by writing to support@gocosmic.dev. You can also lodge a complaint with the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC): https://www.edoeb.admin.ch/, or, if you live in France, with the CNIL: https://www.cnil.fr/.

sections.title: Cookies and audience measurement
body: Cosmic Studio does not load any advertising cookies. Vercel Analytics is treated as a non-essential audience measurement tool and is only loaded after your consent.
You can change or withdraw your consent at any time with the cookie settings button at the bottom of every page.

The Google Calendar booking calendar on the contact page only loads if you click “Show the calendar”; Google may then set its own cookies. Without that click, nothing is loaded from Google, and you can open the booking page in a new tab instead.

sections.title: Use of artificial intelligence
body: Cosmic Studio may build AI-based features into its clients' projects, and uses these tools to write, translate and develop faster. Every piece of content and every delivery is reviewed by a person.
Recommendations produced by AI are for information only and do not replace human judgement. Applications are tested according to industry good practice.
Sensitive data is never shared with third parties without a documented legal basis, or without explicit consent where it is required. The handling of personal data is detailed in the privacy policy.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: These terms of sale apply to the subscription and services offered by Cosmic Studio on www.gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Provider
body: The provider is Cosmic Studio, the trading name of the sole proprietorship (raison individuelle) Matthieu Compérat, chemin de la Montagne 100, 1224 Chêne-Bougeries, Switzerland. This sole proprietorship is not entered in the commercial register, and its affiliation with FER Genève is in progress. Contact: support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Free mockup
body: The mockup and the review of your current website are free and place you under no obligation. They are prepared from the information you send us.

sections.title: Subscribing
body: The subscription is confirmed by a quote, drawn up after a first conversation once we have defined your needs together (pages, options, changes), which you approve in writing. It takes effect when the site goes live.

If you withdraw before the site goes live after approving the quote, the fees set out in the quote remain due. If the subscription includes an item subscribed for 12-month periods, you also owe 12 months of subscription, except for options with no commitment, which are due for one month.

Two plans are offered: “We take care of everything”, where we make the changes you email us, at the frequency set in your subscription, and “You stay in control”, which also includes an editing tool to publish your news and opening hours yourself, along with a news section.

sections.title: Price and billing
body: The prices shown on the Pricing page and in the pricing simulator are indicative: the subscription price, based on the options chosen, becomes final in the quote you approve. If the base price or the price of an option changes, the new price may apply when the subscription renews; we then propose it to you in a new quote, for your approval.

The subscription is billed yearly or on a monthly payment schedule. With yearly billing, the invoice is payable by bank transfer within 30 days of receipt. With the monthly schedule, each instalment is payable by bank transfer on the date shown on the invoice.
Guidance, team reinforcement and custom projects are billed at the day rate or on the basis of a quote; either is given to you before any work starts.

Cosmic Studio is not registered for VAT: VAT does not apply (article 10 of the Swiss VAT Act) and the prices shown are net prices. If Cosmic Studio becomes registered, VAT at the applicable rate will be added to the prices; we will inform you in writing at least 30 days before it applies.
A client based in France and registered for VAT declares the VAT on our services themselves (reverse charge); if they can deduct it, it costs them nothing overall.
Prices in euros (EUR) apply to clients not based in Switzerland, whether businesses, independents or associations. For clients based in Switzerland, prices are in Swiss francs (CHF).
Bank charges for international payments, as well as duties and taxes due in the client's country, are borne by the client.
Any late payment automatically incurs default interest of 5% per year.

sections.title: Duration and commitment
body: The subscription has no minimum term and can be cancelled at any time with one month's notice, as long as it includes no item subscribed for 12-month periods: the “You stay in control” plan, domain name management, an email address or an option marked “1-year commitment” in the pricing simulator.

As soon as one of these items is active, the subscription runs in 12-month periods, renewed automatically, to cover the registration of the domain name and the email address, and the setup of the editing tool and of the options concerned.

The first 12-month period starts when the site goes live if the subscription already includes one of these items, otherwise on the day the first of them is activated. If you add one of these items during a current period, a new 12-month period starts for the whole subscription on the day it is activated, so your subscription still has a single renewal date each year.

To stop the subscription from renewing, or to remove one of these items at the end of the period, email us at support@gocosmic.dev: your email must reach us no later than two months before the end of the current period, and we confirm in writing that we have received it. For example, for a period ending on 31 March, the deadline is 31 January. If your email reaches us after that date, the subscription and these items renew for a further 12 months.

Two months before that deadline, we send you an email reminding you of it, with the steps to follow. The deadline applies once we have sent this reminder, even if it did not reach you. If we did not send it, you can cancel at any time after the renewal, with one month's notice.

You can switch to the “You stay in control” plan at any time. Switching back to “We take care of everything” must be requested no later than two months before the end of the current 12-month period and takes effect at the end of that period, as the editing tool cannot be removed before then.

sections.title: Options
body: You can add an option at any time: we set it up as soon as possible, and it is billed from the following month.
Swiss hosting cannot be removed once active, because it reflects a commitment we made for you. The number of pages can be reduced, provided the extra pages are removed from the site.

Any reduction of an option requires one month's notice: fewer pages, a lower frequency (content changes, news, articles) or the removal of an option with no commitment. Removing an option subscribed for 12-month periods follows the rules in “Duration and commitment”. If an option is changed too often, we may switch it to a 12-month commitment.

If you do not have a domain name, its management by Cosmic Studio is part of the subscription and is billed as an option. You can remove this option while keeping your subscription only if you take over the renewal of the domain name yourself; hosting the site on Vercel remains included in the subscription. If you already have a domain name, the domain name and email address options are not offered; we can send you a quote for help with your domain name and email addresses.
The email address option opens new mailboxes, for example on your domain name: we do not transfer the content of your existing mailboxes.

A content change is one request, which can group several changes. A complete redesign of the site is not a content change. If a request seems too large compared with what your subscription provides, we may decline it and offer you another solution: a quote, or adding or changing an option. News and articles do not count towards content changes.

Options marked “1-year commitment” (domain name, email address, news published for you, site in English, tracking your position on Google, visit statistics and detailed statistics, AI-assisted articles, extra mailboxes and forwarding addresses) are subscribed for 12-month periods and can be removed at the end of a period, if you ask us no later than two months before it ends (see “Duration and commitment”). The frequency of news posts and articles can be reduced with one month's notice.
The other options (contact form, online booking, customer reviews) can be removed with one month's notice.
When an option is removed, the content that goes with it disappears from the site, for example the news section and its posts, or the English version.

By default, your website is hosted in the European Union. If this location does not suit you, you can ask us for hosting in another country; we will then tell you whether it is possible and at what price.

sections.title: Cancellation
body: You can cancel at any time by emailing support@gocosmic.dev; we confirm in writing that we have received your email. The site stays online until the end of your subscription: for a subscription with no minimum term, the end of the month after the one in which your email reaches us, or, if it is billed yearly, the end of the paid year, with no refund for the remaining months; for a subscription that includes an item subscribed for 12-month periods, the end of the current period if your email reaches us no later than two months before it ends, otherwise the end of the following period.

You leave with your content, meaning everything you provided for building the site (texts, photos, articles…), and with your domain name. Leaving the subscription comes with no exit penalty: you pay for the current period and, if your email reaches us after the deadline, for the following 12-month period. The only other possible cost is the transfer fee, if you ask for the code before reaching 36 months of subscription (see “Ownership”).

sections.title: Ownership
body: Your texts, images and domain name belong to you from day one. The site's code is transferred to you free of charge after 36 months of subscription. Before then, it can be transferred to you for a transfer fee, which depends on the number of months left until 36 months; its amount is stated in the subscription quote.

Once the code is transferred, we give you, on request, a Git repository containing it, whether or not your subscription continues. As long as the subscription continues, we host and manage the site; if you leave, hosting and managing it are your responsibility.

For a one-off project, the code belongs to you once the project has been delivered and all its invoices paid in full. We deliver it in a Git repository, and hosting it is your responsibility, unless you then switch to a subscription for ongoing care.

sections.title: Your obligations
body: You provide the texts, images and information needed to build or update the site. The timelines we announce start once we have received them.

We commit to the launch date set at the start. It is postponed by the length of the delay if your content reaches us late, or in the event of force majeure. If we are late although you sent us all your content and information on time, the first month of the subscription is free. Cosmic Studio is not liable for a delay or a failure to perform caused by force majeure.
We set up your legal notice and privacy policy from the information you provide; you read them over, approve them and remain responsible for them.

sections.title: Liability and availability
body: Cosmic Studio takes reasonable steps to keep the site available, but cannot guarantee that it will never be interrupted. If a prolonged outage is attributable to Cosmic Studio, the period concerned may be extended by the same length of time.

Cosmic Studio's liability is limited to the price of the current subscription period (one month, or 12 months for a subscription in 12-month periods), or to the price of the quote for a one-off project, except in cases of intent or gross negligence.

sections.title: Personal data
body: The processing of personal data is described in the privacy policy.

sections.title: Governing law and disputes
body: These terms are governed by Swiss law, whatever the client's country.

In the event of a dispute, the parties first seek an amicable solution, before any legal action. Failing that, the courts of Cosmic Studio's seat, in Chêne-Bougeries (canton of Geneva), have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to the mandatory provisions that protect consumers.
